title: The dead are a wall
intent: Reveal control, a hard boundary and the cost of heroic intrusion.

shots.action: Rook rotates one iron ring and a black thread pulls taut.
shots.emotionalBeat: A small exertion commands an appalling force.
shots.soundMood: Iron click, taut thread creak; low drum pulse.
shots.background: One right hand, left-wrist cord and iron ring foreground; taut thread runs out toward screen left, stone wall soft behind.
shots.choreography: 0–1s thumb touches ring; 1–4s one quarter-turn tensions one visible thread; 4–10s hold tension and planted hand.
shots.cameraChoreography: Tight prop insert; do not add other hands, magic beams or illegible symbols.
shots.lighting: Vermilion shrine lantern key from frame right, cold cyan exterior rim; dry ochre late-light field for s01–s03, painted indigo darkness at the gate thereafter.
shots.focus: Keep the acting hands and target on one readable focus plane; background soft only where it does not hide a story action.
shots.motion: One defined subject action with weighted start and held end pose; background limited to cloth and dry dust. Camera never chases the impact.
shots.extras: Only the named cast in this setup. Squadron wides show three red and three indigo representatives; pennants imply the remaining dead without additional live characters.
shots.loreNotes: Two enemy squadrons killed each other; five living outcasts control the dead only at their defensive boundary. Wen is an adult present freely. Fixed impairments and props never change.
